title: Arkret Identity Resolution
description: Canonical did_core_id/did resolution state, owner-published evidence and service-route bootstrap contracts. A did is a standard bare DID and a did_core_id is the stable Arkret business identity projected by a registered DID method adapter.

authenticated_service_resolution.description: Public method-native service evidence. All route coordinates are derived from the independently verified DID state; this carrier creates no signed address history.

normalized_did_document.description: Exact normalized document verified by the registered DID method; project(did) equals service_id and its unique ArkretService entry selects service_kind.

method_evidence_boundary.description: Inclusive adapter-defined history interval covered by this evidence. For a method without native history the from and to values are identical synthetic values for the one verified state.

webvh_method_history_evidence.description: Complete did:webvh log, proof and witness material routed by evidence_kind webvh_log to the active did:webvh adapter. log_entries is the gap-free native history from inception through boundary.to_version_id, not a resolver summary or a partial segment. witness_records is the complete did-witness.json record set required by every witness policy active in that interval and is empty only when no entry activates a witness policy. The receiver independently verifies SCID derivation, every versionId/hash-chain link, every controller proof, rotation authorization, all applicable witness thresholds, the exact boundary endpoints and canonical equality of the terminal state with normalized_did_document. Canonical encoded evidence MUST NOT exceed 1 MiB; an over-limit service history is ineligible for retained historical-signer and governance-Station bootstrap and fails closed rather than returning partial evidence.

evidence.description: Closed canonical evidence receipt for exactly the inclusive boundary. method MUST be webvh and method_proofs MUST carry the matching webvh_log row; the public evidence evaluator checks its history_head against boundary.to_method_history_head. This receipt summarizes the independently reverified log_entries/witness_records but never replaces them.

log_entries.description: Exact ordered native did:webvh entry objects from inception through the selected terminal entry. The adapter applies the registered did:webvh parameter-name and proof rules and rejects gaps, duplicates, surplus entries after boundary.to_version_id, or a first entry other than inception.

witness_records.description: Exact native did-witness.json record objects needed by log_entries. Records are keyed uniquely by versionId; missing, duplicate, invalid or surplus records fail closed. The array is empty exactly when the verified log activates no witness policy.

did_web_method_history_evidence.description: Bounded current DID Document retrieval evidence routed by evidence_kind did_web_document to the active did:web adapter. The boundary endpoints MUST be identical synthetic values. Canonical encoded evidence MUST NOT exceed 1 MiB.

evidence.description: Closed canonical document-bound evidence receipt. method MUST be web and method_proofs MUST be empty; document_digest and boundary synthetic head are cross-checked by the public evidence evaluator.

did_key_method_history_evidence.description: Bounded deterministic local expansion evidence routed by evidence_kind did_key_expansion to the active did:key adapter. The boundary endpoints MUST be identical synthetic values. Canonical encoded evidence MUST NOT exceed 1 MiB.

evidence.description: Closed canonical local-expansion evidence receipt. method MUST be key and method_proofs MUST be empty; the public evidence evaluator recomputes document_digest and the synthetic boundary directly from did.

method_history_evidence.description: Adapter-routed evidence. evidence_kind is the single-source discriminator: the receiver resolves it through did-method-adapter-registry.json method_evidence_kind, which is unique across active adapters, to exactly one active adapter for this versioned schema. The evidence carries no adapter_version; an adapter change requires a new schema/operation version rather than a registry drift under the same wire shape. Unknown evidence kinds fail closed.

resolution_commitment.description: Owner-committed current did and method-native history position. For a deterministic method, method_history_head and version_id use the adapter-defined deterministic canonical values; they are never omitted.

principal_resolution_update_payload.description: Payload for ak.identity.resolution.update in the actor's Principal Control Realm. Admission projects did to the envelope actor_id and performs a strict CAS against the signed resolution_projection expected_revision precondition before accepting a method-valid successor.

principal_genesis_event.description: The accepted identity-control Realm genesis Event. It is resolution history head 0 and commits the initial resolution; its derived Realm id, actor, purpose and initial projection are cross-bound by the principal resolution evidence evaluator.

resolution_update_event.description: One accepted post-genesis resolution successor Event. Its exact resolution-typed current result expected_revision precondition and predecessor fields are mandatory under Event dispatch.

principal_resolution_projection_attestat.description: Station assertion that resolution_projection is the current accepted value of this account's singleton resolution typed current result. It carries no PCR realm id, Event, receipt or RealmCommit: the public consumer verifies the account pair, the projection and the bounded method history, not the account's internal control stream.

account_id.description: Complete account identity covered by the Station attestation. Both principal and Station components participate in equality.

method_history_evidence_digest.description: sha256 over RFC 8785 JCS of the exact method_history_evidence object carried in the same response. It binds the attestation to the bounded adapter evidence so neither half can be swapped.

issued_at.description: MUST be strictly earlier than expires_at and MUST equal proof.created_at.

expires_at.description: Hard freshness bound. A consumer performing a security-sensitive action MUST refetch at or after this instant; a cache never extends it.

principal_resolution_projection_attestat.description: Complete Station-signed projection attestation. The detached proof signs the canonical transcript above; proof.created_at MUST equal attestation.issued_at.

public_principal_resolution.description: Complete public resolution response for one account selected by account_id. It is the only unauthenticated resolution surface and it MUST NOT carry principal_control_realm_id, PCR genesis Event, genesis receipt, resolution Events or accepted RealmCommit; those are account-internal audit material served only by the authorized audit operation. A consumer verifies the service route for account_id.station_id, then the attestation proof, then project(did)=account_id.principal_id and the bounded method history; a set of bare unproven fields is not a valid response.

account_id.description: Complete public selector and external account identity. No PCR-derived value participates in account equality.

resolution_projection.description: Current accepted value of the singleton resolution typed current result. resolution_event_ref is an opaque head coordinate for staleness comparison; it is not a handle for fetching that Event through any public surface.

method_history_evidence.description: Bounded adapter-routed evidence for exactly the projected history position. It is required: without it the projection is an unverifiable server assertion.

principal_resolution_audit_request.description: Authorized request for account-internal resolution audit evidence. Authorization is the current holder session bound to the exact AccountId. Recovery actors first finish the existing recovery transaction and become the current holder; v1 does not create a second audit authorization path. Caller-declared intent is never authorization. Unknown account, wrong AccountId and unauthorized caller are externally indistinguishable and share the anti-enumeration outcome.

account_id.description: station_id MUST equal the serving Station DID. A different value is an unknown account, not a referral.

history_depth.description: Maximum number of post-genesis predecessor resolution Events to disclose, counted backwards from current_resolution_event. 0 discloses the current head only. A value outside the closed range is param_invalid; an implementation MUST NOT substitute a private cap.

after_resolution_event_ref.description: Known ancestor already held by the caller. The disclosed segment stops exclusively at it, so only the unknown suffix is returned. It MUST be the genesis Event or an accepted ak.identity.resolution.update in this account's current lineage; a ref outside that lineage is param_invalid with reason resolution_history_ancestor_unknown. Supplying it with history_depth 0 is param_invalid, because depth 0 discloses no predecessor and the cursor could not apply.

principal_resolution_audit_evidence.description: Account-internal resolution audit and recovery evidence for one account selected by account_id. It is served only by the authorized audit operation. PCR genesis, realm and RealmCommit material support account-local audit and recovery; they MUST NOT be compared as external identity, MUST NOT be required to validate an ordinary federated Event, which is verified from its producer proof and the RealmCommit that admitted it, and MUST NOT be republished on any unauthenticated surface.

account_id.description: Complete account selector. The remaining PCR material is recovery/audit evidence and does not change account equality.

principal_control_realm_id.description: Realm id derived from principal_genesis_event under the registered PCR derivation rule; it is not a producer-selected alternate scope.

genesis_commits.description: The two consecutive RealmCommit objects accepting principal_genesis_event and founding_device_authorize_event in that order.

predecessor_resolution_events.description: Post-genesis resolution update Events preceding current_resolution_event, ordered from the current event's immediate predecessor toward older events and contiguous with no gaps. The genesis Event is carried separately and MUST NOT be repeated here. The segment ends at whichever comes first: request history_depth items, the exclusive request after_resolution_event_ref ancestor, or head 0. A server MAY return a shorter contiguous segment than requested when a response bound applies, MUST NOT return more items than history_depth, and MUST NOT skip an intermediate Event.

accepted_commit.description: The authority-signed RealmCommit that accepted current_resolution_event in the Principal Control Realm stream.

history_complete.description: True exactly when the disclosed segment reaches its requested stop condition: head 0, or the exclusive after_resolution_event_ref ancestor. False means disclosure was truncated and next_audit_cursor is present. Omitted history is unknown rather than absent.

next_audit_cursor.description: Present exactly when history_complete is false. It equals the value.resolution_event_ref inside the exact expected_revision precondition of the oldest supplied Event, which is that Event's guarded immediate predecessor and the next Event the caller has not seen. The caller continues the audit walk by requesting again with this ref already held; it never skips the omitted segment or reads a payload echo.

route_mirror_hint.description: Transport-only hint for one route-mirror service. mirror_id is only a stable lookup identity and MUST be paired with independently verifiable service_resolution first-hop material; neither the did_core_id nor the carrier authorizes target-service routing or Realm access.

mirror_id.description: Stable did_core_id of the candidate route-mirror service. A bare did_core_id is never a route or authority.

service_resolution.description: Discovery carrier for the mirror itself. The target requires independent current DID verification.

route_assistance.description: Transport-only bounded discovery hints. They do not authorize routing, extend outer token expiry, or supply current DID state.

mirror_hints.description: At most four independently routable mirror hints. Each item carries the mirror did_core_id together with a service_resolution_carrier; bare URLs and bare core ids are not valid items.

resolution_url.description: Bounded canonical HTTPS discovery URL for the public method evidence of the expected service. Fetch success supplies no authority or freshness.

service_route_projection.description: Derived route projection of one verified service DID state (sync/service-surface.md section 2.6). Every coordinate comes from the independently verified method-native state and its unique ArkretService entry; the projection creates no signed address history and carries no method evidence.

service_kind.description: Expected role selected from the DID Document; the value space is registry/service-kind-registry.json filtered to the context of the consuming result.

resolution_event_ref.description: Adapter coordinate emitted by the active did-method-adapter-registry row; it is a method-state position, never an Arkret Event handle.

base_url.description: Unique canonical absolute HTTPS service entry of the selected ArkretService entry, normalized with exactly one trailing slash.

founding_device_authorize_event.description: The founding device authorization Event immediately following the PCR realm.create Event.
